blocks.text: This page belongs to the Mehtab Kot sequence and begins with a written order spreading through Punjab, Kashmir, and the hill regions that they should not spare anyone with unshorn hair. The proclamation turns the whole countryside into hostile ground for the Khalsa.

Because refuge disappears so widely, a small group of Singhs withdraws into the rough riverine country associated with Mehtab Kot. Their survival depends on obscurity, endurance, and whatever shelter the wild terrain can still provide.
Spies and officials quickly notice their vulnerability and urge a rapid strike. The page therefore frames Mehtab Kot as both a refuge and a trap, created by persecution and exposed by informers.
